2893-3875-7886-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1417-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:

1417-4210-4279--216.description:

When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.

Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sanar, Unfinished Genius // Wild Idea.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

1451-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
1451-5708-7275.description:

Pyreheart Wolf dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Pyreheart Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Pyreheart Wolf, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

You control another nonland creature.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 3.

3213-6712-6781.description:

Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.

1168-1651-4935-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4935-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.

1168-1651-4935-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1236-1477-2018.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Construct and Thopter, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Repeat.

654-1479-4862-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-4862-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating an untapped copy of the Everywhere token due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 3.

883-2760-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.

883-2760-4279.description:

When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1374-1849-3626-5499--24.description:

Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Raptor Hatchling, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Raptor Hatchling, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Raptor Hatchling, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Raptor Hatchling trigger.
Resolve the Raptor Hatchling trigger, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Raptor Hatchling, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Raptor Hatchling trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing.
You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
3132-3750-5231.description:

Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
106-2034-2646-5267.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Clue ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
The Human Soldier leaves the battlefield, triggering Angelic Sleuth, creating a Clue token.
Repeat.

2178-2842-4283-4314.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
2178-2842-4283-4314.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other nontoken creatures.
Pawn of Ulamog, Blood Artist and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve both Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Resolve both Blood Artist triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve both Whisper triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 1, returning target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing an Eldrazi Spawn token and any other nontoken creature.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers once, while Blood Artist and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Repeat from step 4.
